The following events took place in '''3674 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invades the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bomodon]], and a [[Elin Garza's platoon|Republic platoon]] under the command of [[Elin Garza]] begins a ten-month [[Battle of Bomodon|campaign]] to drive them offworld.<ref name="Ency" />
